algorithm_profile.objective: Find minimum sum(w_i*length_i) over binary prefix codes whose codeword lengths are at most L.
algorithm_profile.nodeset_reduction: Each symbol i contributes a node of weight w_i and width 2^-d at each depth d in 1..L. A full binary tree with n leaves has nodeset width n-1.
algorithm_profile.package_merge: Scale all widths by 2^L. Initialize one ascending-weight item for each symbol in every depth-width list and set the remaining target to (n-1)*2^L. Process widths from smallest upward. Let q be the least significant set bit of the remaining target width. If current width exceeds q, the instance is infeasible. If it equals q, select the lightest item and subtract q. Pair the remaining consecutive items from lightest upward into double-width packages, discard an unpaired heaviest item, and merge packages into the next width list.
algorithm_profile.tie_breaking: Lists are sorted by nondecreasing item weight; equal-weight items may be selected in either order because only the optimal weighted cost is returned.
algorithm_profile.complexity: O(nL) time and O(nL) auxiliary storage for n<=12 and L<=6.
algorithm_profile.overflow_bound: The weighted code length is at most n*L*max_weight=72000000, within signed 64-bit range.

output.meaning: Minimum total weighted codeword length; -1 for invalid input.
